precision_validation.evidence_notes: Only platform-level detection-p QC (864,614/865,918 probes passing p≤0.05) and genome-wide FDR (Benjamini-Hochberg) correction are reported; no ICC/CV, no technical replicates, no test-retest reliability for the methylation array or the flow-cytometry assay.

Only two bins charted: pre_exercise_baseline and 0_to_lt30min (1 min post, within_window). No samples beyond the immediate-post point and no gt72h outside-window recovery sample; single bout only, no Support-B cross-bout monitoring.

Methylation measured in a magnetic-bead-sorted NK-cell fraction rather than whole PBMC, improving cell-type specificity relative to prior PBMC-level studies; however, the purity/QC of the sorted NK fraction itself (e.g., post-enrichment %CD3-CD56+) is not reported — flow cytometry was run on the PBMC gate to check subset redistribution, not on the EasySep output used for DNA methylation.

precision_validation.individualization: Single pre-post pair per participant (n=5); no repeated baseline, no ICC/CV, no responder definition; only group-level DiffScore/FDR reported, not individual donor trajectories.
precision_validation.evidence_notes: Observed within-subject group-level change; natural variability/measurement error not quantified, per manual guidance this cannot be called an individualised marker.

precision_validation.functional_evidence: not_demonstrated — DAVID/GO functional annotation is interpretive/bioinformatic, not a measured immune-function assay
precision_validation.evidence_notes: No direct cytotoxicity/degranulation/clinical outcome measured. FASLG is discussed narratively as mechanistically plausible for NK-cell cytotoxicity (FAS-FASLG apoptosis pathway) and compared to an external study's gene-expression timing (Mooren et al.), but no functional assay or clinical endpoint was measured within this study.

precision_validation.replication: A narrative cross-method/cross-study comparison is reported for 2 unrelated KIR genes (KIR2DS4, KIR3DL1) from the authors' own prior TDBS study (different participants, different method): 6 commonly analyzed CpGs were unaltered in both studies. This is not a validation of the current genome-wide NK-methylation findings themselves.
precision_validation.evidence_notes: Single pilot study, n=5, no independent replication cohort or validation of the main 33-target/25-gene result set; the KIR2DS4/KIR3DL1 cross-study comparison concerns different genes from a different cohort and method (TDBS vs EPIC array) and does not validate the genome-wide array findings.

precision_validation.field_feasibility: Fully reported reagent/kit/platform protocol (EasySep NK enrichment, column DNA isolation, MethylationEPIC BeadChip); authors flag a DNA-yield bottleneck for isolating methylation from NK subpopulations (CD56bright/dim) and small sample size (n=5) as feasibility constraints for scale-up.
precision_validation.evidence_notes: Resource- and labour-intensive workflow (density-gradient PBMC isolation, magnetic-bead NK sort, genome-wide array) explicitly reported; not amenable to simple field deployment.

eligibility_opinion.rationale: A single identifiable bout (incremental cycle-ergometer step test to exhaustion) with a pre-exercise baseline and ≥1 post-cessation immune-related sample satisfies Core A under contract 2.1-2.2 (p.3 §2, §2.2: 'before (t0) and 1 min after (t1)'); adults only (mean age 61.4±8.0 y, p.4 Table 1), no exposure threshold applies.

unresolved_questions: Manual requires 'sorted-cell purity/QC' for R03, but the flow cytometry in this paper controls NK-subset redistribution within the PBMC gate, not the purity of the EasySep-enriched NK fraction actually used for DNA methylation; there is no dedicated field for 'post-enrichment sort purity' distinct from 'subset distribution within PBMC' — which field (cell_context free text vs missing_data) should carry this null result, and should it be flagged NR explicitly at the sample_set level?

Whether precision_validation rows should be generated once per report/cohort (as done here, anchored to the epigenome marker family) or separately per marker_family when a report has multiple marker families in one measurement set (here: epigenome plus NK_count_or_cytotoxicity flow data) is not specified in the manual; this pilot file used one set of 7 rows anchored to the main epigenome marker family and folded the flow-cytometry null result into domain notes rather than a second full set of 7 rows.

FASLG (M-R03-003) was selected post hoc via DAVID/GO annotation rather than being named in the original genome-wide aims/methods; candidate_selection_rule vocabulary has no option cleanly describing 'single gene surfaced by post-hoc functional-annotation tool from a statistically-thresholded hit list' — used other_source_defined_rule/posthoc_or_results_only as the closest fit.

author_window_interpretation was coded redistribution_interpretation because Discussion §4.2 explicitly engages the CD56dim-redistribution hypothesis to explain the study's own null flow-cytometry result; a different reviewer might code this no_window_interpretation since the redistribution framing is used to explain an absence of effect rather than to interpret the methylation findings themselves — flagging as a genuine judgement call for comparison with B.
